{{Quote|Have you ever wanted to be a pirate? I know I sure have. I spent over 20 years in the Imperial Navy combating pirates, blowing up ships, and being struck in the head, I found out something about myself! I want to be a pirate!|Boyrake, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Ac" />}}
'''Boyrake''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. Boyrake joined the Imperial Navy shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation of the Empire]] and had a long career that lasted over twenty years, eventually reaching the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. During this career, Boyrake mostly fought [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]] and unwittingly developed some kind of admiration for them. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Boyrake retired after being injured in a battle. Struck in the head, Boyrake realized he always wanted to be a pirate. The Imperial Captain retired on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] and gathered information about local pirates, notably the [[Canyon Corsairs]].<ref name="SWG:Ac" />
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Boyrake encountered a spacer in the [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|Imperial Outpost]] on Lok and provided the location of the [[Canyon Corsair's Stronghold]] to this adventurer.<ref name="SWG:Ac" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Boyrake]]
Boyrake was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ac" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Boyrake was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>

Due to the nature of some characters in ''Galaxies'', Boyrake's gender and appearance were randomized during each server reset. This NPC was only known as "a commoner" in the game. The name "Boyrake" appeared in the "waypoint" to the Canyon Corsair's Stronghold provided to the player upon talking with the NPC.<ref name="SWG:Ac" />
